evidence.quote: climb up the rope ladder to the west...Follow the path to it's end where you'll find stairs that lead out of the cave...Once out of the cave you'll be right next to Sheran.

subject: Danil
text: Speaking to Danil on the floor in the cave grants the key to Sheran Castle.

evidence.quote:
When you reach the cave on your way to Sheran you'll see Danil on the floor. 
Speak with him and he gives you a key to Sheran Castle.

subject: Switch

evidence.quote:
This is where you use the key from 
Danil. Open the door to the west and flip the switch.

subject: Treasure Chest

evidence.quote:
Behind the door to the

enter the room they were in and search the bookcase for a

subject: Sheran
text: Entering the town area of Sheran triggers an unwinnable battle that sends the hero and Lufia back to Alekia.

evidence.quote:
entering the town area triggers 
dialogue followed by a battle which you cannot win, and then more dialogue. 
Once you regain control of Hero and Lufia, you're back in Alekia.

subject: Lilah
text: Speaking with Lilah on the second floor of Alekia Castle causes her to join you.

evidence.quote:
head to the castle and speak with Lilah to have her join you, she's on 
the second floor.

subject: Princess
text: The Princess is located on the third floor of Alekia Castle.

evidence.quote:
Next head up to the third floor and speak with the Princess. 
Now it's time to depart for Chatam.

subject: Bridge

evidence.quote:
Speak to the kid east of the inn. Then cross the bridge to trigger dialogue. 
Now it's time to head to the port town of Treck.
